references.text: Both verses are part of the same narrative sequence where Boaz instructs Ruth to stay close to his servants for protection and recognition.
The verses describe the same event: Ruth's initiative (v.7) leads to Boaz's protective command (v.15).
A strong theological contrast: Pharaoh denies resources and demands labor, while Boaz grants permission to glean and protects the vulnerable.
Verse 23 confirms that Ruth followed Boaz's specific command in verse 15 to stay close to his servants.
